_comment: Public release metadata. Historical migration boundaries remain explicit.

notes.en: Moves durable session, communication and usage state to SQLite-backed stores. Retain an offline backup; automatic rollback across this migration is unavailable.
notes.zh-CN: 会话、通信及用量的持久状态迁入 SQLite。请保留离线备份；无法跨过本次迁移自动回退。

notes.en: Adds persisted worker service records that older cutex versions cannot read. Keep a backup and do not downgrade a store containing worker services to an older release.
notes.zh-CN: 新增旧版 cutex 无法读取的 worker 服务持久记录。请保留备份，不要把包含后台应用记录的数据退回旧版。

notes.en: Job Service 0.1.3 can persist unconfirmed jobs when follow-up is ended. Job Service 0.1.2 cannot read that state. Retain an offline backup and do not downgrade the Job Service or restore older binaries over a store containing those records.
notes.zh-CN: Job Service 0.1.3 在结束后续处理时可持久保存 unconfirmed 作业。Job Service 0.1.2 无法读取该状态。请保留离线备份；包含这些记录后，不要降级 Job Service 或用旧二进制覆盖该存储。

notes.en: After 0.2.6 starts, rollback to 0.2.5 is unsupported. New personal-assistant, schedule and integration-service records are outside the old reader contract. Keep a complete consistent offline backup from before upgrading and the upgrade-run backup. The 0.2.5 managed backup does not include personal-assistant or schedule stores; preserve consistent snapshots of those stores separately when retaining data created by 0.2.6.
notes.zh-CN: 0.2.6 启动后，不支持退回 0.2.5。新增的个人助理、定期任务和集成服务记录超出旧版读取契约。请保留升级前完整且一致的离线备份，以及升级程序生成的备份。0.2.5 的内建备份不包含个人助理和任务日程存储；保留 0.2.6 新增数据时，还须单独保留这两份存储的一致快照。

notes.en: Adds personal assistants and recurring tasks, project controls and delivery recovery. Includes Native 0.172.0-r70 and Claude claude-r59; reuses the original Job Service 0.1.3. This is a one-way upgrade from 0.2.5: rollback to 0.2.5 is unsupported after 0.2.6 starts. Keep a complete consistent pre-upgrade offline backup and the upgrade-run backup; retain personal-assistant and schedule snapshots separately for data created by 0.2.6.
notes.zh-CN: 新增个人助理与定期任务、项目控制和投递恢复改进，提供 Native 0.172.0-r70 与 Claude claude-r59，复用原始 Job Service 0.1.3。这是从 0.2.5 开始的单向升级：0.2.6 启动后，不支持退回 0.2.5。请保留升级前完整且一致的离线备份和升级程序备份；0.2.6 新增的个人助理与任务日程数据还须单独保留一致快照。
